Default-OFF byte-identical: with FR13_COMMITTER_SYNCKILL=0 (default) the committer takes the EAGER_PACK :6761 packed sync + first-draft kernel/legacy loop + the existing HtoD writeback verbatim — the SYNCKILL fork and device arm are never touched. Lever = pure-integer / location-only: the accept / path-LCP / 3-way-bonus decision is integer token-id == compares, a parent walk, an LCP scan, an earliest-leaf strict-> tie-break — no float, no reduction, no reorder. G2 moves only TRANSPORT: (i) WHERE the inputs live when the kernel reads them (device tensor vs a `.tolist()` of that same device tensor = bit-identical ints), and (ii) WHEN/WHERE the outputs cross to host (side-stream event + device->device vs inline `.cpu()` = same bytes, later, off the main thread). `_fr13_committer_kernel_dev` is a verbatim transcription of the byte-validated `_fr13_committer_kernel`; the on-device acc_path emit reuses the SAME root-down ancestor walk as the token emit. The device->device output_token_ids copy is byte-identical because the kernel pads out_tokens with _PAD=-1 (= the legacy fill_(-1)) and truncates rows to max_spec_len+1, so the slice copy reproduces the host scatter exactly.
